scope: First batch: four accepted enemy units, five actions each, down/front direction only. 20 clips / 120 frames. Four independent directions are defined for later expansion.
palette_rule: Accepted ivory / blue-grey / restrained brass. No baked hit flash, bloom, smoke, projectiles or cast shadows.
export_rule: Source grids are divided into fixed equal cells; resize full sheet once using the clip common registered cell size, then uniformly blit all scaled cells with the same offset into 128x128. Calibrate only from reference frame 0 versus accepted canonical neutral bbox. Never normalize or recenter each pose separately. Preserve source RGBA.

units.name: 轻型巡逻兵
units.identity: Compact ivory biped with domed helmet / blue-grey top cap, horizontal black visor with a tiny amber-red sensor, narrow blue-grey waist, stout separate legs, brass joint caps. Anatomical RIGHT arm = viewer LEFT in front is the short integrated bolt-projector. Anatomical LEFT arm = viewer RIGHT is the chunky two-prong manipulator. Keep exactly one head, one torso, two arms, two legs and two feet.

idle: neutral accepted stance, both feet grounded
torso and helmet rise about one logical pixel, shoulder couplings relax
neutral stance, tiny manipulator finger flex
torso returns to the start with restrained one-pixel settle
move: right-leg forward contact / left-leg trailing contact
right-leg support / left knee begins to lift
left leg passing, torso near neutral
left leg extends toward front, right knee bends
left-leg forward contact / right-leg trailing contact
left-leg support / right knee begins to lift
right leg passing, torso near neutral
right leg extends toward front, ready to connect smoothly to frame 0
attack: neutral alert stance with right projector lowered
right projector elbow raises and aims forward, left claw counterbalances
short wind-up, knees brace, muzzle remains short
projector recoils briefly backward at the release pose, no flash or projectile drawn
right projector settles forward again
both arms return to the exact neutral stance
hit: torso recoils backward, knees bend slightly, both feet retain their support reference
maximum restrained recoil, helmet tips with torso while limbs remain attached
recover to neutral, no white/red recolour
death: neutral stance
sensor dims, knees begin to buckle
knees compress, torso lowers while arms bend inward
one knee touches down, torso pitches toward its right side
robot tips sideways, head and tools remain attached
torso and shoulder contact the ground, legs fold
all motion settles into one readable compact wreck
same settled wreck with dark sensor and no motion, keep all original components once

units.name: 近战切割工蜂
units.identity: Low broad ivory rounded shell with a blue-grey top service cap, horizontal front sensor, brass joints. Exactly FOUR short walking legs, plus TWO distinct forward tool arms. Anatomical RIGHT tool arm = viewer LEFT has one broad toothed circular saw; anatomical LEFT tool arm = viewer RIGHT has one gripper. Never become an upright humanoid or grow extra walking feet.

idle: neutral low stance, four legs supporting
shell lifts one logical pixel and gripper opens slightly
neutral shell height, gripper closes slightly
settle back to frame 0, blade stays stopped
move: diagonal right-front / left-rear legs extend toward contact
that diagonal supports while opposite diagonal lifts
opposite diagonal passes under the chassis
opposite diagonal stretches forward toward contact
diagonal left-front / right-rear makes contact
that diagonal supports while first diagonal lifts
first diagonal passes under chassis
first diagonal stretches forward to connect with frame 0
attack: neutral low stance, circular saw on viewer left
right saw arm draws back slightly, left gripper braces
saw arm lifts and blade angle advances, four legs keep support
right saw sweeps forward/down in a short visible cutting strike, no slash effects
saw arm retracts from strike, shell settles
return to neutral, tool side and four legs unchanged
hit: shell lowers two logical pixels while four legs compress
shell tips slightly back, saw/gripper remain attached
four legs extend back to neutral
death: neutral stance
top body lowers, tool arms lose tension
four legs begin folding inward
shell sinks toward ground, cutter arm rests lower
four folded legs tuck alongside shell, blade stops
front of shell reaches ground, gripper relaxes
one compact low wreck settles, still only four legs / one saw / one claw
same still wreck, sensor dark, no extra duplicated detached pieces

units.name: 履带重装机
units.identity: Squat broad ivory central tower with a low blue-grey circular top cap, ONE horizontal front sensor and ONE short blunt front projector; exactly TWO thick dark-blue-grey caterpillar track pods under ivory covers, connected with brass mounts. No arms or legs, no long tank gun, no giant turret.

idle: short projector rises one logical pixel in restrained adjustment
neutral projector height, slight top cap settle
return to original alignment, tracks motionless
move: track tread phase 0, both pods grounded
track tread phase 1 scrolls within same pod silhouettes
track tread phase 2, slight one-pixel chassis settle
track tread phase 3
track tread phase 4 / half-loop
track tread phase 5
track tread phase 6, restrained one-pixel chassis settle
track tread phase 7 ready to wrap into phase 0
attack: neutral compact front projector
central tower braces slightly lower, projector aligns forward
short wind-up, tiny sensor stays restrained, no glow haze
front projector slides backward two logical pixels in a clear recoil pose, tracks stay planted
projector returns forward halfway
exact neutral projector/tower alignment returns
hit: central tower tips briefly two logical pixels toward its right while both track pods stay planted
tower counter-settles one logical pixel toward center
recover to neutral with original two-track envelope
death: neutral stance
central tower lowers slightly and sensor dims
tower tilts down into the low chassis
top cap lifts a little on its existing hinge but stays attached
projector sags down, track motion stops
central tower collapses low between two complete track pods
one compact wreck settles with two tracks and single cap/projector intact
same still wreck, sensor dark, no extra track or detached duplicate cannon

units.name: 悬浮侦察机
units.identity: Compact ivory central fuselage with blue-grey top vent, ONE small front vertical optical sensor and tiny brass lower probe. Exactly TWO enclosed horizontal fan pods on two short lateral struts; each pod contains exactly ONE FOUR-BLADE rotor with brass hub, two motors total. No legs, tail, wings or newly added weapons.

idle: neutral hovering height, four-blade rotors at phase 0
rotors advance phase 22.5 degrees, body lifts one logical pixel
rotors advance to phase 45 degrees, body at neutral height
rotors advance to phase 67.5 degrees, body lowers one pixel before returning to frame 0 phase
move: slight constant forward pitch, rotor phase 0
same pitch, rotor phase 11.25 degrees
same pitch, rotor phase 22.5 degrees, body lifts one pixel
same pitch, rotor phase 33.75 degrees
same pitch, rotor phase 45 degrees
same pitch, rotor phase 56.25 degrees
same pitch, rotor phase 67.5 degrees, body settles one pixel
same pitch, rotor phase 78.75 degrees ready to wrap
attack: neutral front-facing hover
central optical module tips forward slightly for target lock, fans stabilize
tiny bottom probe aligns forward with the original body, no new gun
brief restrained forward pitch as sensor/probe emits an implied pulse, no beam or glow drawn
body pitches halfway back to level
exact original neutral hover returns
hit: body rolls slightly toward its right while both pods remain connected
counter-roll toward center, fan count/blade count unchanged
recover to neutral hover at original height
death: neutral hover, rotors turning
rotor phase advances more slowly, body drops a few pixels
one support strut folds a little, body descends farther
both fan struts fold inward, body approaches its ground-projection anchor
lower fuselage contacts the ground, two pods lower alongside
body rests low, rotor motion comes to stop
one compact wreck with both housings and both rotors present once
same still wreck, dark sensor, no shadow or spare rotor
